family_attribution: On materially regretted decisions, take direction-adjusted student-minus-expert deltas in the fixed scaled 18-feature space, discard deltas <= 0.01, average positive deltas within each family, and divide each family's evidence by total evidence on that decision.
weakness_score: sum(regret * family attribution share) / all recorded decisions * games-with-attribution / all games
profiles: hole-weak: fixed richer-student policy uses magnitude-40 penalties/rewards except that it omits hole-family penalties
well-weak: fixed richer-student policy uses magnitude-40 penalties/rewards except that it omits well-family penalties
natural-rl: frozen rl@3000 state from the Day 4 final artifact
success_criterion: For each synthetic profile, the intended family is top 2; the two intended-family score vectors differ by at least 0.01 in L1 distance; diagnosis is unchanged after adding/changing irrelevant hidden-weight fields; and history collection plus diagnosis does not mutate a student.
development_note: An initial magnitude-8 construction failed the two-game smoke because well weakness ranked fifth. Before the final run, retained penalties/rewards were strengthened uniformly to magnitude 40; no diagnosis threshold, seed, budget, mapping, final result, or success criterion was inspected or changed.
no_tuning_rule: This revised construction, thresholds, seeds, budgets, mappings, and criterion are fixed before the final run. A null final result is reported without retuning against final cases.
